description: This file is a core framework bootstrap script for OpenCart, initializing autoloaders, registry, configuration, error handling, event system, request/response handling, database, session, cache, template, language, URL, document, and executing pre-defined actions and routing logic.

classes.name: Opencart\System\Engine\Autoloader
classes.description: Handles class autoloading for the framework.

classes.name: Opencart\System\Library\Log
classes.description: Handles logging of errors and messages.

classes.name: Opencart\System\Engine\Factory
classes.description: Provides factory methods for creating objects.

classes.name: Opencart\System\Engine\Loader
classes.description: Handles loading of models, controllers, and other resources.

classes.name: Opencart\System\Library\Response
classes.description: Handles HTTP response data and headers.

methods.name: register()
methods.description: Registers a class or namespace with the autoloader.

methods.name: set_error_handler()
methods.description: Sets a custom error handler function.

methods.name: set_exception_handler()
methods.description: Sets a custom exception handler function.

methods.name: addHeader()
methods.description: Adds an HTTP header to the response.

methods.name: setcookie()
methods.description: Sets a cookie in the HTTP response.
